name: Arcanist Greater Exploits – Jon Brazer Enterprises — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Arcanist Greater Exploits – Jon Brazer Enterprises from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Arcanist Greater Exploits" but are not part of the Arcanist Greater Exploits – Jon Brazer Enterprises entry, which is unchanged.

Table: Arcanist Greater Exploits
Arcanist Exploit	Prerequisites	Description	Source
Alter Enhancements (Su)	Arcane Weapon arcanist exploit	Spend one arcane reservior point to temporarily modify the enhancements on a weapon, suit of armor, or shield	PZO1129
Burning Flame (Su)	Flame Arc arcanist exploit	When using flame arc, spend an additional arcane reservior point to set creatures on fire	PZO1129
Consume Primal Magic (Su)	Swift Consume arcanist exploit	You can consume primal magic events, as the Consume Spells class feature	PZO9495
Convert Wand (Su)		Spend one arcane reservoir point to temporarily convert a wand to a cure spell of the same level and caster level	PZO9488
Counter Drain (Su)	Counterspell arcanist exploit	Recharge your arcane reservoir when you successfully use the counterspell exploit	PZO1129
Counterspell Primal Magic (Su)	Counterspell arcanist exploit	You can counter a primal magic event, as the Counterspell exploit	PZO9495
Create Primal Event (Su)		Spend two arcanist reservoir points to create a primal magic event	PZO9495
Dancing Electricity (Su)	Lightning Lance arcanist exploit	When using lightning Lance, spend an additional arcane reservior point to deal half damage to creatures adjacent to the target	PZO1129
Energy Absorption (Su)	Energy Shield arcanist exploit	When your energy shield absorbs at least 10 points of damage, you can use another exploit that deals the same type of damage, reducing its cost by one point	PZO1129
Greater Counterspell (Su)	Counterspell arcanist exploit	When using counterspell, you can expend a spell slot of the same level that the spell you counter	PZO1129
Greater Metamagic Knowledge	Metamagic Knowledge arcanist exploit	You gain one metamagic feat as a bonus feat, which you can swap for another metamagic feat by spending one arcane reservoir point when you prepare spells	PZO1129
Greater Spell Disruption (Su)	Spell Disruption arcanist exploit	Spend an arcane reservoir point disrupt a spell effect or magic item, as dispel magic	PZO1129
Greater Spell Resistance (Su)	Spell Resistance arcanist exploit	When you use the spell resistance exploit, your spell resistance is increased	PZO1129
Hellfire Ray (Su)	Flame Arc arcanist exploit	When using flame arc, spend an additional arcane reservior point to draw half the damage from unholy power that is not subject to fire resistance and sickens Good creatures	PZO9492
Icy Tomb (Su)	Ice Missile arcanist exploit	When using ice missile, spend an additional arcane reservior point to coat the target in rime that entangles and deals Dexterity damage	PZO1129
Lingering Acid (Su)	Acid Jet arcanist exploit	When using acid jet, spend an additional arcane reservior point to deal persistance damage	PZO1129

Redirect Spell (Su)		Spend one arcane reservoir point to redirect a spell for one round	PZO1129
Resistance Drain (Su)	Greater Spell Resistance arcanist exploit	End your spell resistance when it protects you from a spell to recharge your you can end it to recharge your arcane reservoir	PZO1129
Siphon Spell (Su)	Greater Spell Disruption arcanist exploit	Use greater spell disruption to recharge your arcane reservoir	PZO1129
Spell Thief (Su)	Spell Tinkerer arcanist exploit	Spend one arcane reservoir point to steal a spell affecting a creature	PZO1129
Suffering Knowledge (Su)		When you fail your saving throw against a spell, spend one arcane reservoir point as an immediate action to temporarily prepare that spell	PZO1129
